# Anyang Chemistry (安陽字煉)

A combination game for Chinese characters: start with strokes, combine them by
position into components and characters. Recipes are Ideographic Description
Sequences (奶 = ⿰女乃). Traditional Chinese first; audience mostly in Taiwan.

## Start here

- `README.md`: overview, quickstart, layout.
- `AGENTS.md`: agent operating instructions.
- `DECISIONS.md`: durable project decisions.
- `docs/architecture.md`: engine, board rules, scripts, hints, mobile plan.
- `docs/game-data.md`: data pipeline and the `game-data.json` contract.
- `docs/development.md`: local workflow.
- `docs/deployment.md`: static hosting and release checklist.

## Layout

- `packages/core`: dependency-free TypeScript engine.
- `data`: vendored sources, curated TSVs, generator, generated game data.
- `apps/web`: Vite + Svelte 5 client.

## Validation

```bash
./scripts/check-all.sh
```
